# Menu

A popup list of actions or choices opened by a button.

- Status: implemented
- Category: container
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “menu-button”; HTML `<button aria-haspopup> with role=menu, or a popover listbox`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **button**: Opens the menu; aria-expanded.
- **surface**: Overlay, elevation 2.
- **item**: An action or a choice; a chosen one has a check.

## Variants

- `actions`: role=menu.
- `choice`: role=listbox with aria-selected (language, theme).

## States

- `closed`
- `open`
- `item-hover`
- `item-focus`
- `item-selected`: A check mark.
- `item-disabled`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter, Space, Down | Open; actions focus the first item, choices focus the selected option when available. |
| Up, Down | Move. |
| Escape | Close and return to the button. |
| Home, End | First, last item. |
| Tab, Shift+Tab | Close and continue through the page. |
| Letters | Type-ahead to a matching item; repeated letters cycle. |

## Accessibility

- Role: menu / menuitem, or listbox / option
- Name: The button's label.
- A menu of links is a disclosure with links, not role=menu.
- Disabled items stay discoverable with aria-disabled but cannot be activated.
- The runnable reference demonstrates focus, type-ahead, selection, dismissal and viewport placement; the product owns actions and persistence.
- Placement: CSS anchor positioning holds the menu below its trigger at the start edge and flips it when space runs out (anchor-name on the trigger, position-anchor on the menu); a script places it where the engine lacks anchor positioning.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 2.1.1 Keyboard (A)
- 2.4.3 Focus Order (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-cluster">
  <button
    class="nd-button nd-button--quiet"
    type="button"
    id="ex-actions-trigger"
    popovertarget="ex-actions"
    aria-haspopup="menu"
    aria-expanded="false"
    aria-controls="ex-actions"
  >
    Document actions
  </button>
  <div
    class="nd-menu"
    popover
    id="ex-actions"
    role="menu"
    aria-labelledby="ex-actions-trigger"
  >
    <button class="nd-menu__item" type="button" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">
      Duplicate
    </button>
    <button
      class="nd-menu__item"
      type="button"
      role="menuitem"
      tabindex="-1"
      aria-disabled="true"
    >
      Archive (unavailable)
    </button>
    <button class="nd-menu__item" type="button" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">
      Export
    </button>
  </div>
  <button
    class="nd-button nd-button--quiet"
    type="button"
    id="ex-choice-trigger"
    popovertarget="ex-choice"
    aria-haspopup="listbox"
    aria-expanded="false"
    aria-controls="ex-choice"
  >
    Reading density
  </button>
  <div
    class="nd-menu"
    popover
    id="ex-choice"
    role="listbox"
    aria-labelledby="ex-choice-trigger"
  >
    <div
      class="nd-menu__item"
      role="option"
      tabindex="-1"
      aria-selected="true"
    >
      Comfortable
    </div>
    <div
      class="nd-menu__item"
      role="option"
      tabindex="-1"
      aria-selected="false"
    >
      Compact
    </div>
    <div
      class="nd-menu__item"
      role="option"
      tabindex="-1"
      aria-selected="false"
      aria-disabled="true"
    >
      Custom (unavailable)
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<p class="nd-text-caption" id="ex-menu-status" role="status"></p>
```
